Description

AWS is seeking an experienced Senior Industry Specialist – Capital Markets and Banking to join the APJ Financial Services Industry (FSI) Business Unit, based in Seoul, South Korea. In this role, you will be the trusted industry advisor for South Korea's leading exchanges, securities firms, broker-dealers, asset managers, hedge funds, wealth managers, and banks — helping them accelerate business transformation through AI, Agentic AI, and Cloud technologies on AWS.
Financial services globally are at an inflection point: Generative AI, Agentic AI, and tokenisation of real-world assets are fundamentally reshaping how capital markets operate — from trading and settlement to risk management and client engagement. Korea is at the forefront of this shift, with regulators and institutions actively embracing digital asset infrastructure, and AI-driven automation. This role sits at the intersection of these trends, helping customers reimagine their business models and accelerate new capabilities enabled by Cloud.
This role is ideally suited to someone with experience in buy-side or sell-side financial institutions, or banking, who believes that Generative AI, Agentic AI, tokenisation, and Cloud will be the primary drivers of growth and transformation across financial services in Korea.

Key job responsibilities
• Drive Capital Markets and Banking adoption of AWS AI and Cloud technologies across all South Korean customers in the segment
• Apply deep industry expertise to accelerate customer Business Transformation, AI, and Cloud journeys — delivering market insight, tailored presentations, and actionable recommendations
• Partner with the Sales team (Korea FSI Account Managers, Solutions Architects) to identify and shape opportunities, then actively support progression through the sales cycle
• Engage business and technology stakeholders at all levels, including Heads of Trading, Chief Risk Officers, Chief Investment Officers, Heads of Digital Assets, Heads of Technology, and COOs at Korean financial institutions
• Build long-term, trusted advisor relationships with customers, positioning AWS as a strategic partner for their business transformation — not just a technology vendor
• Develop and execute geographic sales strategy for Capital Markets and Banking in Korea — including AI-led Sales Packages, industry narratives, and go-to-market accelerators
• Proactively identify and apply emerging AWS and partner technologies (Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, Step Functions, blockchain/DLT services) to Capital Markets and Banking use cases, translating innovation into customer-relevant solutions
• Collaborate with AWS industry and specialist teams (global and APJ) to scale successful AI and tokenisation initiatives, share best practices, and triage opportunities
• Support executive engagement — lead executive briefings, participate in industry events, and align AWS solutions with customer business transformation goals
• Manage a portfolio of proactive and reactive accounts — approximately 5 proactive strategic accounts (~33% of time), with the remainder split between reactive requests and industry strategy development

A day in the life
The role balances business development with deep domain expertise, always centred on helping customers transform their business through AI and Cloud. On any given day you might:
• Lead an executive briefing with a Korean securities firm's CIO on how Agentic AI can automate trade surveillance workflows and enable autonomous compliance monitoring
• Collaborate with Solution Architects to design compliant-by-design architectures covering cryptography, key management, and tokenisation infrastructure for a customer launching a security token platform
• Lead a workshop with a bank's digital assets team on building a tokenisation platform for real-world assets (bonds, real estate) using AWS services
• Support Korea FSI account teams on positioning AI-led transformation — connecting Generative AI capabilities to customer pain points such as trade lifecycle automation, intelligent risk analytics, and personalised wealth advisory
• Develop an industry Sales Package showing how Agentic AI on AWS can orchestrate end-to-end post-trade settlement, reducing T+1 operational risk
• Join a regional call with APJ and global Capital Markets specialists to share customer wins on AI adoption patterns

About the team
The AWS APJ Financial Services Industry Development (FSI) team supports one of AWS's largest and highest growth industry segment across Asia Pacific and Japan. The team spans banking, insurance, capital markets, and payments across multiple APJ geographies, with a strong focus on security, compliance, and innovation. Priority areas include Generative AI, Agentic AI, operational resilience, customer experience transformation, tokenisation and digital assets, and real-time analytics — helping financial institutions modernize and transform their businesses on AWS.

Basic Qualifications

  • 10+ years of solving problems with technology in the Global Financial Services Industry experience
    - Experience developing strategies that influence leadership decisions at the organizational level
    - Experience in Go-To-Market, Business Development, Sales, or Consulting
    - Experience partnering with executive-level leaders to identifying and solving business issues
    - Demonstrable understanding of AI/ML, Generative AI, or Agentic AI and their application to financial services business problems
    - Fluent in Korean (native or bilingual); professional English proficiency

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience as a founder or executive focused on related segments, or as a practice leader or business unit owner
    - Experience selling to Fortune 1000 or Global 2000 organizations
    - Front-office experience at a securities firm, exchange, asset manager, bank, or fintech in Korea
    - Deep familiarity with Korean financial regulatory landscape (FSC, FSS, KISA) including digital asset regulations
    - Understanding of capital markets infrastructure: trading systems, market data, risk management, post-trade processing, and cryptographic key management
    - Existing relationships within the Korean financial services ecosystem
    - Experience with tokenisation, digital assets, security token offerings (STOs), or blockchain/DLT in financial services
    - Bachelor's degree; advanced degree (MBA, CFA, FRM) is a plus

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies, from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups, use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Go-to-Market (GTM) Enablement develops the capabilities that help Stripe’s customer-facing teams deliver greater value to users. We define expectations for role excellence, build practical learning experiences, and equip managers to reinforce new skills and behaviors.

Enablement Business Partners connect our global strategy with the needs of specific regions, segments, roles, and business teams. They partner with leaders to identify performance needs, adapt enablement for the field, and embed learning into everyday coaching and business rhythms.

What you’ll do

You’ll lead a team of Enablement Business Partners responsible for deploying and adapting enablement across Stripe’s GTM organization. You’ll shape how the team works at scale, including how it prioritizes demand, responds to urgent needs, measures impact, and gives leaders visibility into progress and tradeoffs.

You’ll serve as a trusted partner to the Global Head of GTM Enablement and senior GTM leaders. You’ll combine field insights, performance data, and business context to identify needs, guide investments, and help customer-facing teams improve how they serve Stripe’s users.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute an Enablement Business Partner strategy aligned with Stripe’s GTM priorities
  • Lead and develop a team of Enablement Business Partners, strengthening their capabilities in consulting, stakeholder management, learning delivery, data interpretation, and change leadership
  • Establish a consistent intake, prioritization, planning, and escalation model that balances strategic priorities with urgent business needs
  • Partner with GTM leaders to identify performance and capability gaps, then translate them into targeted plans for specific regions, segments, and roles
  • Coordinate the deployment and adaptation of global programs while embedding applied learning, manager coaching, and reinforcement into business rhythms
  • Use conversation intelligence, competency data, learning signals, and business indicators to prioritize investments, evaluate behavior change, and make recommendations to senior leadership
  • Build cross-functional partnerships and repeatable processes that clarify ownership, improve execution, and increase the impact of the Enablement Business Partner function

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 10+ years of experience in GTM leadership, sales enablement, sales effectiveness, or a related field
  • Experience leading and developing a team in a complex, high-growth organization
  • Experience building and scaling enablement programs or business-partner models across multiple regions, segments, or GTM roles
  • Experience building prioritization and operating models, influencing senior stakeholders, and leading complex cross-functional initiatives
  • Experience using performance data to identify skill gaps, guide coaching, and connect enablement to proficiency, behavior, and business outcomes

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in a quota-carrying sales or sales leadership role
  • Experience enabling global teams and adapting programs across regions, markets, and cultural contexts
  • Experience leading organizational change involving sales methodologies, processes, tools, or operating models
  • Experience using artificial intelligence and automation to improve enablement delivery, personalization, reporting, or operational effectiveness
  • Experience using Gong or a similar conversation-intelligence platform

In 2018, Bitvavo launched the first version of its digital assets trading platform, to bridge the gap between traditional currencies and digital assets. By offering transparent fees, a wide range of assets and an easy to use platform, Bitvavo is making the currency of the future accessible for everyone.

In two years' time, Bitvavo has established itself as the market leader in the Netherlands and one of the largest in Europe, with over one million users exchanging tens of billions of digital assets a year.

About the Opportunity

We are looking for a talented Senior Data Platform Engineer to join the Storage and Messaging team in our established Platform Engineering team.

We are an exchange. System scalability, performance and engineering productivity matter in everything that we do. Our platform domain is committed to fostering autonomy by providing engineering teams with paved paths to develop robust, secure, compliant, and scalable systems. We're seeking exceptional talent to join us in making this a reality

  • Build a self-service platform that empowers teams to build at scale across diverse database and messaging technologies, enabling the seamless and reliable development of application and data products.

  • Continuously evolve our platform to support new data models and use cases, including structured and semi-structured data models, stream processing, and data governance at scale .

  • Build and maintain a secure, scalable, and compliant data infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code and automation.

  • Enable data ingestion, processing, and consumption at scale. All are offered entirely as self-service.

  • Experience with SQL and No-SQL databases. Understanding of data warehousing and batch/stream processing is a plus.

  • Experience with distributed messaging systems such as Kafka, including cluster operations, topic/partition design, consumer group tuning, schema registry, and stream processing with Flink

  • Fluency in using infrastructure as code tools (like Terraform) and container orchestration platforms (like Kubernetes) in a cloud-first environment.

  • Exceptional communication skills. We expect engineers to take ownership of their work end-to-end and communicate directly with stakeholders.

We are committed to building a team that reflects the diversity of the communities we serve and creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. Join us and be part of a team that values and celebrates your unique contributions.

Bitvavo does not accept resumes from staffing, search, or recruitment firms without a signed agreement. If you send us a resume without such an agreement, we may contact the candidate directly without any obligation whatsoever and no fee of any kind will be paid should we hire the candidate.

What We Offer

At Bitvavo, we believe in attracting, motivating and retaining talented people through market-competitive offerings that go beyond compensation alone. To learn more about our total rewards package and the benefits we offer, visit our Life at Bitvavo page.

descriptions.job-18s1gsk:
About Morpho

Morpho is a leading Decentralized Finance (DeFi) lending protocol backed by a16z crypto, Paradigm, Ribbit Capital, Apollo, Vaneck, Coinbase Ventures, Variant and 50 others to build an open credit network giving anyone, anywhere, access to the best possible terms. Morpho is experiencing exponential adoption, with over billion in deposits on the network and used by institutional clients including Bitwise, Galaxy, and Anchorage Digital and the largest crypto exchanges, such as Coinbase, Binance, and Kraken. Now, Morpho is scaling its team of contributors to establish itself as the open credit network, not just of DeFi, but of the world.

 

Why Morpho Exists

Everyone has the potential to build something great for the world. But fulfilling that ambition almost always requires more: people willing to trust you with their capital. Yet access to capital still depends on where you live, who you know, and which institutions are willing to trust you. Even when capital is available, it sits fragmented across disconnected networks and hidden behind intermediaries. The result is a system that fails most of the people it should serve. Borrowers overpay. Lenders earn less than they should. Many are shut out entirely, not because they are unworthy of credit, but because today's infrastructure was never built to connect them. Morpho exists to solve this. Full article here.

Location

Paris or remote (from -5h GMT up to +2h GMT to ensure sufficient overlap with the rest of the team).

 

Role

Morpho's Protocol team is evolving the core lending infrastructure that powers products and markets across the ecosystem. As the number of opportunities, integrations, and protocol initiatives grows, the team needs clear product direction on what to build, why it matters, and how to sequence the work.

This role will work with Morpho’s protocol team to shape product strategy and guide execution. You will turn the needs of users and ecosystem partners into a focused roadmap, work closely with protocol and engineering teams to shape solutions, and drive improvements from discovery through launch and adoption. You will operate at the intersection of deeply technical systems, financial markets, and a fast-moving ecosystem.

 

Responsibilities

  • Own the roadmap for Morpho's protocol team, defining the highest-impact problems to solve and sequencing opportunities against company goals, user needs, technical constraints, and ecosystem dynamics.

  • Build and run a continuous discovery process with curators, distributors, integrators, developers, and other protocol users to understand their workflows, pain points, and emerging needs.

  • Translate user and market insights into clear product requirements, decision frameworks, and success criteria that help protocol and engineering teams move quickly with strong rationale.

  • Partner closely with protocol, engineering, research, security, legal, solutions, partnerships, and marketing to take initiatives from early exploration through design, implementation, audit, launch, and adoption.

  • Evaluate product and technical tradeoffs, including when to extend the protocol, improve surrounding infrastructure, enable partners, or deliberately avoid adding complexity.

  • Define and track the signals that show whether protocol initiatives are working, combining quantitative data with ecosystem feedback to guide iteration and future investment.

  • Communicate product direction, decisions, tradeoffs, and release implications clearly to internal teams and external stakeholders.

  • Improve how product decisions are made and documented as Morpho and its protocol ecosystem scale.

 

What Success Looks Like

First 30 days

You understand Morpho's protocol, development and release process, current roadmap, and the rationale behind the major initiatives in flight. You have built relationships across protocol, engineering, research, security, and go-to-market teams, and have started speaking with key curators, distributors, integrators, and developers.

 

First 3 months

You have established a clear, prioritized view of the most important protocol problems and opportunities. The roadmap reflects explicit tradeoffs, user evidence, technical constraints, and measurable outcomes. You have driven at least one meaningful initiative from discovery into execution and proactively keep stakeholders aligned on decisions and changes.

 

First 6 months

You have shipped a meaningful protocol improvement and can show how it advanced user or business outcomes. Product, protocol, and engineering teams have stronger shared context on what to build and why. You consistently identify important user needs, ecosystem shifts, and roadmap conflicts early, and have improved Morpho's product discovery and decision-making process.

 

Must Have Experience & Skills

  • 5+ years building technical products in complex or fast-changing environments.

  • Proven track record taking products or major features from ambiguous problem spaces through launch and iteration.

  • Strong technical fluency, with the ability to reason about system design and constraints, engage deeply with engineers and researchers, and translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences.

  • Excellent product judgment: you can distinguish important user problems from requests, make principled tradeoffs, and focus teams on the work with the greatest impact.

  • Strong user discovery and synthesis skills, with the ability to uncover needs across different user types and turn incomplete or conflicting inputs into clear direction.

  • Experience leading cross-functional work without relying on formal authority.

  • Ability to define success, use quantitative and qualitative evidence, and adapt direction as new information emerges.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, especially in an async environment.

  • Comfort creating clarity and driving decisions in highly ambiguous contexts.

  • Strong ownership and autonomy: you act without waiting to be told.

  • Team-first mindset, low ego.

 

Nice to Have

  • Experience in crypto, DeFi, traditional finance, or fintech.

  • Familiarity with lending markets, smart contracts, or permissionless protocols.

  • Experience shipping products with significant security, audit, regulatory, or governance considerations.

Perks & Benefits

We design benefits around deep work and growth, so you can do the best work of your career. Expect fair, top-tier compensation, real flexibility, time together in Paris, great health coverage, and support to keep learning.

 

Equal Opportunity

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and hire based on talent, potential, and values alignment.

descriptions.job-05l8ybo:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

We are seeking an Event Design Coordinator to manage the intake, production, and quality assurance of event-related creative requests coming from a wide range of teams across the business. This is a builder-and-gatekeeper role: you'll work hand-in-hand with designers to turn varied, often fast-turnaround requests into flawless deliverables, including booth graphics, signage, decks, digital assets, swag, and invites, while proactively spotting risks (timeline, brand, print spec, or logistical) before they become problems.

We are not looking for someone who simply routes tickets. We're looking for someone who understands both the creative process and the operational realities of live events well enough to catch a misaligned bleed line, a missing dieline, or a vendor deadline that's about to slip, and to fix it before anyone else notices.

Responsibilities

  • Request Intake & Triage

    • Serve as the primary point of contact for event-related creative requests coming from varied teams across Tether.

    • Scope each request clearly: deliverable type, format (print vs. digital), quantity, deadline, dimension, venue/vendor constraints, and brand requirements.

    • Flag conflicting timelines, unrealistic turnarounds, or missing information immediately, and propose a workable plan rather than waiting to be asked.

    Design Collaboration & Project Management

    • Brief designers with complete, unambiguous specs so work is right the first time.

    • Manage multiple concurrent event workstreams across different teams and deadlines without dropping details.

    • Track status across all active requests and proactively surface bottlenecks before they affect the event date.

    Quality Assurance (Print & Digital)

    • Review every designer deliverable before it goes back to the requesting team, checking brand consistency, copy accuracy, resolution, color mode (CMYK vs. RGB), bleed/trim/safe zones, file formats, and platform specs (e.g., booth panel dimensions, social crop ratios, slide aspect ratios).

    • Catch errors that would be costly or embarrassing to fix on-site or post-launch (typos, wrong sizing, low-res exports, broken links, outdated logos).

    • Maintain a QA checklist/process that scales across event types and gets sharper over time.

    Event Documentation & Knowledge Management

    • Document and file all assets, briefs, and final deliverables for each event in a shared drive, using a clear, consistent structure.

    • Organize files so the wider team can easily find past work, reuse assets, and cross-reference specs, timelines, or creative direction from previous events.

    • Keep a running record of vendor details, production specs, and lessons learned per event to speed up planning for future ones.

    Risk & Logistics Ownership

    • Anticipate what can go wrong, such as vendor lead times, print production windows, last-minute scope changes, and shipping delays, and build buffer and contingency plans into every project timeline.

    • Coordinate with vendors and print/production partners as needed to confirm specs and delivery windows.

    • Keep stakeholders across requesting teams and design aligned with clear, proactive status updates rather than reactive fire drills.

    Cross-Team Partnership

    • Act as a trusted liaison between business requesters and the design team, protecting designers' time from ambiguous briefs while protecting requesters from missed deadlines.

    • Continuously improve the intake and review process based on what goes wrong (or almost goes wrong) on each event.

  • 5+ years of experience in event marketing, event production, creative operations, or project management with a strong events component.

  • Proven experience managing print and digital production processes; you know what a dieline is, what "safe area" means, and why RGB assets can't go straight to print.

  • Strong organizational and multitasking skills: demonstrated ability to manage several concurrent, cross-functional requests with competing deadlines.

  • Sharp attention to detail, comfortable being the last line of defense before a deliverable ships.

  • Experience reviewing and giving actionable feedback on creative work from designers, without needing to be a designer yourself.

  • A proactive, risk-first mindset: you naturally ask "what could go wrong here?" and build a plan around the answer.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication; comfortable managing stakeholders across different teams with different priorities.

  • Familiarity with project management tools (Asana, Monday, or similar) and design review tools like Figma

  • Experience setting up shared drive structures or asset libraries for teams.

  • Fluent in English and Spanish / Italian is a plus.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @tether.to or @tether.io

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

The Role

Square is building a best-in-class, high-impact field sales organization, and we are looking for an exceptional Territory Account Executive — someone who consistently exceeds expectations, takes full ownership of their territory, and brings Square’s mission of economic empowerment directly to the businesses that need it most. 

This is a field-driven, execution-focused role designed for individuals who thrive in dynamic, demanding environments. You will spend most of your week out in the market — meeting businesses, conducting live demos, and closing deals with confidence. The pace is fast, the expectations are high, and your ability to operate strategically and decisively will determine your success.

You will serve as Square’s presence and competitive advantage in one of our highest-opportunity markets — responsible for building pipeline from the ground up, elevating Square’s visibility in your community, establishing high-value partnerships, and helping local businesses grow through our ecosystem of industry-leading software and hardware.

If you are motivated by impactful work, driven to outperform, and eager to join a high-performance team with high standards, this role is built for you.

The territory for this role can be located in Riverside, Corona, or San Bernardino.

You will:

Lead your market with disciplined, in-person execution

  • Spend ~80% of your week in the field — walking your territory, engaging local businesses, and driving 50–60 targeted business visits each week.
  • Run a full-cycle, self-sourced sales motion: generate leads, identify needs, deliver compelling demos, and close deals across Square’s full product suite.

Establish yourself as the go-to Square expert in your city

  • Build strong, trust-based relationships with local sellers by being present, reliable, and value-driven.
  • Partner cross-functionally to ensure a seamless onboarding experience and fast time-to-value for new sellers.
  • Implement a disciplined referral strategy to turn every new customer into future opportunities.

Build a high-velocity pipeline from the ground up

  • Develop a repeatable top-of-funnel engine through door-to-door outreach, community engagement, events, networking, and targeted partnerships.
  • Work with channel partners to generate a consistent, high-quality referral stream that grows over time.

Master your verticals and sell with precision

  • Build deep expertise in key verticals — including restaurants, retail, and services — to diagnose challenges and position the right Square solutions.

Achieve exceptional results in a high-accountability environment

  • Maintain strong operational rigor in Salesforce: track activity, manage pipeline, and forecast accurately.
  • Measure performance frequently and improve continuously.
  • Consistently exceed quota within a culture where high standards are the norm.

You have:

  • Experience exceeding sales targets, selling a diverse ecosystem of products, and closing complex deals
  • Ability to drive deals independently in a fast-paced, dynamic environment 
  • Business development experience (e.g. hunting and cold calling)

  • A collaborative and team player mentality
  • Prior Salesforce experience or equivalent
  • Even better:
    • 2+ years of payment processing OR related technology (i.e. payroll, loyalty, time management)
    • 1+ years of relevant audience experience (experience working in/selling to restaurants, retailers or services based businesses)

descriptions.job-120onyc:
The Opportunity 

If you enjoy applying your quantitative and ML skills to real-world problems, coding production-quality analysis and tools, and working in a fast-paced environment with immediate and tangible feedback, our Summer Internship Program is ideal for you. 

At Brevan Howard, we build systematic and discretionary investment processes that rely on rigorous analysis of a vast universe of data, such as asset prices, macroeconomic indicators, news, sell-side research, and trading signals. Transforming this data into actionable insights is central to how we win, and we’re looking to find the next generation of portfolio managers and quants through our internship program—people who are eager to push the frontier of research and engineering in global macro investing. 

Overview & Responsibilities 

You will work directly with senior professionals to provide immediate impact on a range of projects: 

  • Our Internship Program starts with one-week in-depth training to prepare interns for the desk. This covers a range of topics relating to Financial Markets including Macroeconomics, FX, Digital Assets, Interest Rate Derivatives, Equity Rates, Bonds, Credit and Fixed Income, Trading Strategies, Risk Management, Excel and Python, and the latest AI tools and LLMs. 

  • During the program, working in a fast-paced environment, interns will work for the Data Sourcing and Strategy team to learn the acquisition of new data assets, manage complex data projects, provide expertise in data alternatives across asset and category types, and partner with our Investment Professionals to analyze their data requirements. 

  • Additionally, interns will benefit from key talks, a mentor program, social events and interactions with some of the most respected and talented individuals in their field.  

  • This internship is devised to provide candidates with an invaluable education on the workings of a macro hedge fund and the regulatory environment through a two-way process to determine if Brevan Howard and the intern are a compatible fit. 

  • The goal of our summer internship program is to convert top performing interns to our 2028 Graduate Program. 

Qualifications & Requirements 

  • A penultimate year undergraduate/junior or 1st year master's or PhD student at a recognized University — completed and awarded before July 2028 

  • Strong mathematical, quantitative, problem-solving capabilities, and technical skills in Excel, VBA, and R 

  • An interest and passion for financial markets, trading, and financial products. 

  • The ability to work independently and collaboratively as part of a team. 

  • An entrepreneurial spirit. 

  • Exemplary professionalism with internal and external clients.  

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English. 

Why take this opportunity 

This is a unique opportunity to gain insight into one of the world’s leading firms operating at the forefront of macro trading. At Brevan Howard, we believe the future of investing lies at the intersection of deep domain expertise and cutting-edge technology. As our industry is being reshaped by AI and automation, you’ll see first-hand how LLMs, retrieval, and agent-like systems are being used in the front-office environment at one of the world’s premier macro hedge funds – where correctness, robustness and speed matter. 

Top-performing interns are considered for our Graduate Program the following year and longer-term paths include roles as analyst, quant, and portfolio manager. 

Please note that you may only submit one application to the Summer Internship Program globally. We encourage you to apply to the role and region that best align with your skills, experience, and interests.   

Compensation 

Compensation for this internship is based on an annualized salary of $125,000, prorated for the 10-week duration of the program. All interns also receive a housing stipend and an internship completion bonus.

descriptions.job-1kddwec:
Do you want to lead the engineering functions that decide how a platform screening over a billion dollars of crypto transactions every week is built and run? Are you a DevOps leader fascinated by the possibilities of both agentic software solutions and the usage of agents in the software delivery lifecycle? Are you looking for a values-led company that cares about the growth of its people as much as the strength of its platform?

Elliptic is where ambitious people do the most important work of their careers. We are making crypto safe, secure and scalable, preventing global financial crime, exposing bad actors and protecting the world's financial system as it is being revolutionized. This is work your friends will actually want to hear about. You can expect to work in highly empowered teams, with remarkable breadth and the freedom to turn bold ideas into real impact, supported every step of the way by some of the most brilliant people you have ever called colleagues.

The impact you will have:

This role provides the people leadership for two connected functions at the heart of how Elliptic engineers. On the DevOps side, you keep a latency-sensitive screening platform dependable, cost-effective and scalable as transaction volume and customer expectations grow. On the AI Platform side, you lead the team that acts as Elliptic's centre of excellence for building AI agents, owning the shared frameworks, patterns, MCP management and evaluation capability that every product team draws on. You are a two-way conduit for that centre of excellence: carrying its best practice out to teams, and helping define what those best approaches should be. Reliability remains foundational to everything Elliptic does, and you will champion strong SRE practices across the business, though the SRE function itself sits outside your direct people-management scope. This is a hands-off, strategy and people-leadership role: you lead and grow the people, set the operating model, and make the calls that shape DevOps and AI Platform at Elliptic.

What you will do:

  • Lead, grow and develop the people across two functions, DevOps and AI Platform, owning hiring, levelling, coaching and career development for a combined team of roughly twelve engineers.

  • Set the strategy and operating model for DevOps: release safety, developer experience, observability, cost and the scalability of a latency-sensitive screening platform.

  • Lead the AI Platform function as a centre of excellence, owning the people and operating model behind Elliptic's shared agent-building frameworks and patterns, MCP management, evaluation framework and shared AI infrastructure.

  • Act as a two-way conduit for the centre of excellence: disseminate best practice and reusable approaches out to product teams building their own agents, and channel their feedback back to define and improve those approaches.

  • Partner with the AI Platform technical lead and senior engineers to shape technical direction, bringing people leadership and delivery rather than owning the technical vision single-handedly.

  • Own the cost, scalability and efficiency of the infrastructure as volume grows, bringing a FinOps mindset to infrastructure spend.

  • Champion SRE and reliability practices across the business, partnering closely with the SRE function.

  • Support the infrastructure and process maturity needed for certifications such as ISO 27001 and SOC2, working with InfoSec.

What you will achieve in the first 6 months:

  • Built trust across both functions and their counterparts, and developed a clear, evidence-based picture of the platform's reliability and cost posture and of how the AI Platform centre of excellence currently works and shares knowledge.

  • Shaped and begun executing a people and hiring strategy across both functions, growing DevOps toward its target and building out the AI Platform and AI infrastructure team.

  • Begun operating as an effective conduit for the centre of excellence, strengthening how agent-building best practice, MCP and evaluation approaches are defined centrally and adopted by product teams.

  • Established a clear point of view on AI SDLC and how the platform enables it, and championed SRE practices across the business.

You will be a great fit here if you:

  • Lead through people: you measure your success by the growth and impact of your team, not your own output.

  • Are credible with senior engineers without needing to be the hands-on expert: you ask the sharp question and facilitate the right decision.

  • Are genuinely curious about AI, agents and evaluations, and energised by helping an organisation learn to build with them well.

  • Are honest and pragmatic about timelines and trade-offs, and comfortable owning a long-term build-out across two functions.

  • Care about the mission: providing the infrastructure and intelligence that keep financial institutions safe from crypto crime and sanctions evasion.

Our ideal candidate has:

  • A track record of managing DevOps, platform or infrastructure engineers, including hiring and building a growing team.

  • An infrastructure background (cloud, IaC, CI/CD, observability) deep enough to make sound strategic calls and guide senior engineers toward the right ones.

  • Extreme curiosity about AI and budding hands-on experience with AI, agents and evaluations: not necessarily deep expertise, but a real, demonstrated pull toward the space and the judgement to grow into leading it.

  • A strong interest in the nuances of the AI-assisted SDLC, and the conviction that tooling alone does not make engineers more potent. Adoption, practice and guardrails are what turn AI access into real leverage.

  • Kubernetes literacy, grounded in hands-on experience as an engineer, sufficient to reason about the estate and challenge the team's decisions.

  • AI fluency: candidates must be able to demonstrate practical, responsible use of AI in an engineering context and the ability to set team norms for it. We are looking for an active AI promoter who can reason about where AI adds leverage and where it is a liability in a compliance setting.

Bonus Points for:

  • Experience leading or building an internal platform, ML platform, developer-experience or enablement function.

  • Hands-on exposure to agent frameworks, MCP, or building and running evaluation frameworks.

  • Experience of a company scaling phase.

  • Exposure to ISO 27001 / SOC2 and what they demand of infrastructure and process.

  • Experience with high-throughput, low-latency systems in a regulated or financial context.

  • HODLs Crypto.

Job Benefits

> How we work:

  • Hybrid working and the option to work from almost anywhere for up to 90 days per year

  • £500 Remote working budget to set up your home office space

> Learning & Development:

  • $1,000 Learning & Development budget to use on anything (agreed with your manager) that contributes to your growth and development

> Vacation/ Leave:

  • Holidays: 25 days of annual leave + bank holidays

  • An extra day for your birthday

  • Enhanced parental leave: we provide eligible employees, regardless of gender or whether they become a parent by birth or adoption, 16 weeks fully-paid leave and leave.

> Benefits:

  • Private Health Insurance - we use Bupa!

  • Full access to Spill Mental Health Support

  • Life Assurance: we hope you will never need this - but our cover is for 4 times your salary to your beneficiaries

  • Cycle to Work Scheme

descriptions.job-1oz5fpg:
ABOUT HUT 8

Imagine the ultimate destination for those who want to work at the cutting edge of technology, energy, and infrastructure. Hut 8 is on a mission to build and operate some of the world’s largest data centers for next-generation computing workloads, including AI, Colocation, Cloud, and Bitcoin Mining. We are proud to offer interesting and challenging opportunities for individuals who want to build teams, solve problems, and make an impact from day one. If you’re an ambitious individual looking for a career that is as rewarding as it is challenging, you’ve come to the right place.

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Project Manager manages day-to-day execution of a data center build across internal teams, EPC partners, and vendors, and is accountable for driving actions, risks, and deliverables to closure. The Program Director owns the outcome; the PM owns the machine that produces it - the operating cadence, the decision velocity, and the follow-through that keeps a hundred moving pieces converging on energization.

Some of the key responsibilities you should expect are the following:

Execution Management

Run the project's operating rhythm: weekly execution meetings, action and decision logs, deliverable tracking across engineering, supply chain, construction, and commissioning. Clear blockers fast; when you escalate, bring the recommendation and the trade-offs, not just the problem.

EPC Partner & Vendor Management

Manage GC/EPC partners, consultants, and vendors against contracted scope, milestones, and quality. Run partner coordination meetings, hold deliverable schedules, manage submittal and RFI throughput jointly with engineering, and keep long-lead equipment (with supply chain) tied to the installation schedule.

Scope, Risk & Change Support

Guard scope: catch creep early and route it through the change process. Feed the risk register with emerging design, procurement, and field issues; own mitigation actions assigned to you; and support the Risk & Change Manager on entitlement and pricing reviews.

Cost & Schedule Partnership

Work daily with the Planner/Scheduler and Cost Controller: challenge progress claims, understand critical-path drivers, support forecasts and accrual inputs, and validate invoices against actual progress.

Stakeholder Management & Reporting

Produce sharp weekly project status for the Program Director and leadership - schedule health, top risks, decisions needed, and commitments made. Represent the project in utility, AHJ, customer, and Managed Services coordination as delegated.

Commissioning & Turnover Drive

Own the project-management side of the commissioning runway: Cx prerequisites, vendor technician scheduling, punch velocity, and turnover documentation completeness with the CXQC Field Manager.

ABOUT YOU

-      What we're looking for:

  • 6+ years of project management on data center, mission-critical, or heavy industrial construction programs, with owner's-side or EPC delivery experience.
  • Proven record running execution across owners, EPC partners, and vendors - and driving open items to closure without being asked twice.
  • Working knowledge of construction contracts (GMP/lump sum/EPC), submittal and RFI workflows, and long-lead procurement dynamics.
  • Fluency in P6-driven schedules and earned-value/cost fundamentals - enough to challenge a progress claim credibly.
  • Risk and change process literacy: notices, entitlement basics, and disciplined documentation.
  • Excellent written communication; your weekly report is the project's source of truth.
  • Bachelor's degree in engineering, construction management, or related field; PMP a plus.
  • Comfortable with significant site presence during peak construction and commissioning (up to 50%).
  • Calm and decisive under schedule pressure - the person the room looks at when something breaks.

ABOUT THE WORK ENVIRONMENT

This role can be based full-time at the project site or out of our Miami headquarters. Miami-based employees should expect frequent travel to the project site, including extended periods on-site as project needs require.

WHAT MAKES HUT 8 A GREAT PLACE TO WORK

Hut 8 offers a benefits and wellness program that includes medical, dental, vision, life, and short-term and long-term disability insurance, as well as paid time off. We are proud to invest in building the best team in the industry. At all levels of the organization, we are driven by an entrepreneurial spirit, radical transparency, and relentless growth mentality.

At Hut 8, you will have the opportunity to:

▶ Work with bright, driven peers from a range of educational and professional backgrounds including software development, energy, engineering, entrepreneurship, investment banking, private equity, and management consulting

▶ Design and pitch new products, services, and other initiatives to a leadership team consisting of serial entrepreneurs and seasoned executives and backed by a board of directors consisting of industry veterans of energy, finance, and government

▶ Debate ideas and alternatives in a truly meritocratic setting where the learning curve is steep and the lessons come from both senior and junior members of the team

▶ Build a lifelong network of friends and professional connections at the cutting-edge intersection of technology, energy, and infrastructure
descriptions.job-0lyy75w:
OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa.
 

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
 
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. 
 
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.
 

About The Opportunity

We are looking for a product-driven marketing leader to accelerate the growth and adoption of OKX products across North East Asia.
This is not a traditional brand or events-focused marketing role. The role sits at the intersection of Product, Growth, Marketing and Business, with a strong focus on understanding CeFi products, identifying market opportunities, and translating them into measurable user and business growth.
The ideal candidate has strong product sense, understands crypto users and trading behavior, and is highly data-driven. You should be comfortable working closely with Product, BD, VIP, Affiliate and local market teams to identify growth opportunities, build GTM strategies, and continuously improve acquisition, activation, engagement, retention and monetization.
You will also need strong judgment when operating across different market and regulatory environments, ensuring that growth strategies, user targeting and marketing execution are appropriate for each market.
 

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Own the product growth marketing strategy for NEA, with a strong focus on measurable business outcomes, including user acquisition, activation, trading activity, retention and revenue.
  • Develop a deep understanding of CeFi products and crypto trading, including Spot, Derivatives, Earn, Copy Trading, Trading Bots, VIP products and other key trading tools, and identify which products and features can become meaningful growth drivers in each market.
  • Build and execute product-led GTM strategies based on local user behavior, competitor dynamics and market opportunities rather than relying primarily on brand campaigns or offline events.
  • Work closely with Product, Business, BD, VIP, Affiliate and regional teams to translate product capabilities into user acquisition, conversion and monetization opportunities.
  • Use data to understand the full user funnel, identify growth bottlenecks and continuously optimize campaigns, product positioning, incentives, conversion journeys and user segmentation.
  • Understand and effectively use different digital and growth marketing tools, including performance marketing, CRM, lifecycle marketing, referral, affiliate, KOL/influencer channels, promotions and incentive mechanisms.
  • Develop clear user segmentation strategies across retail traders, active traders, high-value users and other relevant customer groups, and design differentiated product propositions and growth strategies for each segment.
  • Act as the voice of NEA users to global Product teams by identifying product gaps, competitive disadvantages and emerging user needs, and help prioritize opportunities that can materially improve growth.
  • Conduct structured analysis of competitors, including their products, pricing, incentives, campaigns, user journeys and growth mechanisms, and translate insights into actionable recommendations.
  • Establish clear KPIs and measurement frameworks for major marketing initiatives, with strong accountability for their impact on product adoption and business growth.
  • Develop market-specific GTM strategies with appropriate consideration for local regulatory requirements, user targeting, communication boundaries and distribution approaches, working closely with relevant internal stakeholders.
  • Build scalable growth playbooks that can be tested in individual NEA markets and expanded when proven successful.

What We Look For In You

  • Strong CeFi and crypto product knowledge is essential. You should understand how centralized exchanges work and be familiar with major trading products, user journeys and the competitive landscape.
  • Strong product sense — able to understand why users choose one product over another, identify product-market gaps, and translate product capabilities into compelling growth propositions.
  • Highly data-driven and commercially minded. Comfortable using data to diagnose problems, prioritize opportunities and measure whether marketing initiatives actually contribute to user and revenue growth.
  • Strong understanding of digital growth tools and mechanics, including performance marketing, CRM/lifecycle marketing, referral, affiliate, KOL channels, promotions, incentives and conversion optimization.
  • Proven experience driving measurable business or product growth, rather than primarily managing branding, communications, events or community activities.
  • Strong understanding of crypto user behavior, particularly active traders and high-value users. Direct crypto trading experience is highly desirable.
  • Ability to work cross-functionally with Product and Business teams and influence priorities without relying on direct reporting lines.
  • Strong market judgment and awareness of how growth strategies may need to differ across regulatory and market environments.
  • Ability to balance growth ambition with responsible execution, including appropriate user segmentation, targeting, communication and channel strategies.
  • Strong analytical capability in market research, competitive analysis, funnel analysis and campaign performance.
  • Strong communication and leadership skills, with the ability to turn complex product and market insights into clear priorities and executable plans.
  • Experience in major North East Asian crypto markets is highly preferred.
  • Fluency in 1 or more NEA Language and English.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role is not measured primarily by the number of campaigns, events or impressions generated.
We expect this leader to demonstrate measurable impact on:
  • Product adoption and active users
  • Trading activity and revenue
  • Acquisition and activation efficiency
  • User retention and reactivation
  • Conversion of high-potential user segments
  • Successful adoption of priority products in NEA
  • Identification and closing of meaningful product and market gaps
  • Effectiveness of collaboration between Marketing, Product and Business teams

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive total compensation package
  • L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
  • Various team building programs and company events
  • Wellness and meal allowances
  • Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
  • More that we love to tell you along the process!

Nice to Haves

About Us

We’re laying the foundation for a better web which respects the freedom and data of individuals, and empowers developers to build better, more trustworthy online services.


Our remote-first, global team develop open-source software that anyone can use or improve. This includes Polkadot, Polkadot SDK, and Kusama — key parts of the Web3 tech stack, the next generation of the internet. Our mission is to make Polkadot the most active and innovative community in blockchain, powering a new era of connected and decentralised applications.

Parity’s Security Engineering team is at the forefront of protecting the Polkadot ecosystem by designing and implementing secure software, auditing code for vulnerabilities, and building cutting-edge ML tools to automate security analysis. We work closely with development teams to embed security best practices across our open-source stack, ensuring that our blockchain infrastructure is robust, resilient, and secure by design.

About the Role

As a security-focused software engineer, you will go beyond traditional application security - you’ll audit and ideally write secure Rust code where needed, conduct deep manual and automated code audits, and leverage machine learning to enhance security across our ecosystem. This is an opportunity to shape the security landscape of the next generation of decentralized applications and protocols.

  • Assist in developing Secure Software – Write and optimise Rust code to build security-critical components and tools.

  • Code Auditing & Vulnerability Analysis – Perform deep manual and automated code reviews to identify and mitigate security vulnerabilities.

  • ML-Powered Security – Design and implement machine learning models for automated security analysis, anomaly detection, and threat mitigation.

  • Bug Bounty & Vulnerability Management – Manage bug bounty submissions, triage security reports, and collaborate with ethical hackers to resolve issues.

  • Secure Development Best Practices – Work with engineering teams to integrate security best practices into the software development lifecycle.

  • Threat Modeling & Risk Assessment – Identify and assess security risks in our blockchain infrastructure, smart contracts, and core software.

  • Stay Cutting-Edge – Research and implement the latest advancements in secure coding, ML-driven security, and blockchain security.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience with secure coding practices and memory safety concepts.

  • Background in code auditing, vulnerability analysis, or exploit development.

  • Experience triaging and resolving bug bounty reports.

  • Knowledge of machine learning techniques applied to security (e.g., anomaly detection, fuzzing, automated threat detection).

  • Familiarity with cryptographic principles, blockchain security, or decentralized systems.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and an offensive security mindset.

If you're excited about writing secure software, auditing code, and pioneering ML-driven security solutions for Web3, we’d love to hear from you!

About Working With Us

Joining Parity means joining team mates who are genuinely excited about the impact their projects are having, and the opportunity to grow alongside some of the brightest minds in the Web3 space! You’ll work remotely and flexibly, while still getting to meet your team mates throughout the year at team and company-wide retreats.

Upon receiving an offer, all candidates undergo a background check through Zinc, our trusted third-party provider. Team members will be taken on as a contractor via our UK entity. View our Applicant Notice to see how we use your data.

Parity is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome diversity in our global team and care about everyone in our collective feeling included and welcome.

descriptions.job-1mj90g4:
About Us

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.
 
Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.
 
Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

Role Overview

We are seeking a mid-level Regulatory Quant & Intelligence Specialist to sit within the Regulatory Compliance function and build the organisation's AI-native legal and compliance intelligence capability. This role combines regulatory expertise, analytical/quant skills and AI-enabled workflow design to transform how regulatory and legal decisions are made, documented and automated across the business. You will model legal and regulatory reasoning into structured decision systems, design AI-enabled workflows for compliance operations, and ensure outputs remain explainable, auditable and aligned with the firm's risk appetite and regulatory obligations.

Key Responsibilities

Regulatory Decision Modelling

  • Translate legislation, regulatory guidance and internal policies into structured decision frameworks, rule sets and scoring models that can be embedded into compliance processes and tooling.
  • Define quantitative thresholds (risk scores, confidence levels, escalation triggers) that determine when automated decisions are appropriate versus when human review is required, aligned with regulatory expectations and internal governance.

AI-Enabled Compliance Workflows

  • Design and prototype AI-powered workflows for regulatory research, licensing analysis, policy drafting, onboarding/KYC, surveillance and incident management within the Regulatory Compliance function.
  • Collaborate with engineers and data teams to implement LLM/RAG/agentic workflows that support compliance advisory, regulatory mapping and ongoing monitoring, ensuring strong grounding, documentation and audit trails.

Quant Analysis and Evaluation

  • Build and maintain simple analytical/quantitative models to assess regulatory risk, scenario outcomes and potential enforcement impact, supporting proactive compliance strategy and licence/posture decisions.
  • Design evaluation frameworks to periodically test and calibrate decision models and AI-enabled workflows against real-world cases, internal incidents and regulatory feedback.

Regulatory Research and Intelligence

  • Conduct structured regulatory research across key jurisdictions (e.g. Singapore, EU/EEA, UK, Australia, Middle East) and maintain internal views on how evolving rules impact existing and new products.
  • Convert regulatory developments into machine-readable rules, guidance notes and internal playbooks that can be consumed by compliance staff and AI systems.

Governance, Documentation and Stakeholder Engagement

  • Draft and maintain documentation for decision frameworks, model assumptions, limitations and human-in-the-loop controls, aligned with AI governance and compliance best practices.
  • Partner with Legal, Product and Engineering to embed regulatory requirements into product design and internal tools, and support responses to regulators, auditors and internal risk committees where AI-enabled decisions are involved.

Requirements (Mid-Level under Compliance)

  • Quant mindset: technically fluent regulatory professional who thinks in systems - prompts, retrieval and evaluation - and redesign traditional compliance workflows from first principles into executable decision models used by both AI (LLMs, triage engines, agentic workflows, data pipelines) and humans.
  • Instinctively seeks the simplest, most automated way to deliver complex work without compromising quality or auditability.
  • 3–5 years' experience in regulatory compliance, financial services law, or a related role within a financial institution, crypto/fintech firm, trading venue or regulator.
  • Strong understanding of financial services and VASP regulation, licensing frameworks, and cross-border regulatory issues (e.g. MAS, AUSTRAC, FCA, MiCAR, ADGM or similar regimes).
  • Demonstrated ability to independently build structured, tech-supported workflows or internal tools for legal/compliance processes (e.g. using Python, scripting, or no-/low-code platforms).
  • Experience working with or alongside LLMs, APIs, workflow orchestration or data/analytics platforms, with comfort iterating on prompts, retrieval strategies and evaluation metrics.
  • Strong analytical and computational thinking skills, able to formalise complex regulatory reasoning into clear models, diagrams and structured guidance for both humans and systems.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to bridge Legal, Compliance, Engineering and Product, and to explain complex decision logic to non-technical stakeholders and senior management.
  • High degree of professional judgement, integrity and ownership, with comfort operating in fast-moving, ambiguous regulatory environments typical of crypto and fintech.

Profile / Behavioural Traits

  • Systems thinker with a builder's mindset, naturally inclined to redesign workflows from first principles rather than only optimise existing steps.
  • Technically curious and comfortable experimenting with AI tools and emerging technologies within a governed, compliant framework.
  • Pragmatic, commercially aware and able to balance regulatory risk, business objectives and operational constraints when designing decision models.

Why Join Us
At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment. 
Our benefits include:
- Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.
- Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.
- Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world.
- Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.
- Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path.

descriptions.job-13hvh8k:
Senior Data Scientist

Location: NYC (onsite only – not remote)

Alliance is the leading accelerator for crypto & AI founders. Since 2020 we’ve backed 300+ startups (Rain, Pump, Synthetix, Pendle, and many more), now collectively valued at $15B+.

We’re hiring a Data Scientist to join our in-house engineering team. You’ll report directly to Carter (CTO) and will be responsible for owning features from the requirements definition stage to production.

What You’ll Do

  • Own data science and analytics end-to-end: turn ambiguous questions into analysis, models, internal tools, and production systems without waiting on a PM or a large engineering team.
  • Build production Python systems for data collection, enrichment, scoring, and AI-assisted research across internal and external data sources.
  • Develop and improve predictive models: define features, build evaluation datasets, run experiments, catch leakage and data-quality issues, and move successful work from research into reliable production releases.
  • Write SQL and own reporting including dashboards, recurring reports, one-off investigations, and reconciliation against source data.
  • Turn messy data into useful decisions for investing, portfolio support, operations, and growth. The output should be understandable and actionable, not just statistically interesting.
  • Work directly with stakeholders to decide what is worth building, explain findings clearly, and iterate based on how the work is actually used.

What we’re looking for

  • Senior, self-directed data scientist or analytics engineer who can take a loosely defined business problem from first query through a production-quality answer.
  • Deep experience with Python and SQL; comfortable working across notebooks, application code, APIs, and Metabase.
  • Strong applied modeling judgment: feature design, evaluation, missing data, leakage, calibration, interpretability, and knowing when a simple approach is better.
  • Enough data engineering depth to ship your own work: build pipelines, integrate APIs, debug bad source data, and maintain production workflows without heavy engineering support.
  • Clear communicator with good product judgment who can work directly with non-technical stakeholders and turn analysis into a recommendation or operating tool.
  • Extremely high-agency, entrepreneurial, self-driven.
  • Comfortable using modern AI tools and LLMs for analysis, enrichment, evaluation, and automation without treating model output as ground truth.
  • NYC-based or willing to relocate (non-negotiable).

Examples of strong qualifications (good to have but not required)

  • Shipped data products or models that people actually use, with evidence of owning the path from raw data and experimentation through production and iteration.
  • Strong public work: a standout GitHub, useful open-source contributions, published research, technical writing, or unusually good independent analysis.
  • Experience applying data science to venture, finance, marketplaces, growth, CRM, or other messy operational datasets.
  • Experience building LLM evaluation systems, structured extraction pipelines, or AI-assisted research products.
  • Founder or early data hire at a fast-moving startup, especially where you operated without a dedicated data platform or large engineering team.
  • Clear signals of exceptional quantitative ability: strong research, competition results, Math/Physics Olympiad performance, or a top technical academic background.

Why NOT join us

  • Not willing to get hands dirty: doesn’t matter how important you were in past organizations; at Alliance we’re all builders, not managers (even though many of us were managers in past lives).
  • Prioritizing work/life balance: this role demands focus, hunger, and a career-defining level of commitment. You must be locked in.
  • Low agency: if you need someone else to set your priorities or keep you on track, you will fail.
  • You can’t relocate to NYC. This is non-negotiable: our founders are here, and so are we.

Why join us

  • Work with the most ambitious founders in crypto and AI. Learn firsthand from hundreds of startups succeeding – or failing.
  • Join a small, high-trust, high-performance team with outsized impact. We’re ex-Meta, WhatsApp, Coinbase, YC, and have collectively founded multiple venture-backed startups.
  • We’re backed by S-tier investors including Initialized Capital, Founders Fund, Multicoin, and Dragonfly, along with angels such as Balaji Srinivasan (ex-Coinbase CTO), Kevin Weil (CPO at OpenAI), Kevin Lin (Twitch co-founder), and Jeremy Allaire (Circle CEO), among many others.
  • Direct ownership and visibility: your work shapes how the next generation of founders discovers Alliance.
  • Career accelerator: this role sets you up, experience- and network-wise, for any high-impact path in crypto/AI – at startups, venture firms, or your own company.
  • Alliance startups are reinventing industries – from media to payments – and improving the lives of everyday people. You’ll have a front-row seat as they change the world.
descriptions.job-09ugo04:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Privacy Operations team is a pivotal part of the global privacy program at Stripe. Our vision is operational excellence—a team that is proactive, streamlined, and deeply embedded in the way Stripe works. Privacy Operations is the authoritative operational hub for privacy processes, enabling high-quality privacy experiences for users and data subjects, and owning clear and auditable documentation for internal stakeholders and external regulators. We partner with Privacy Legal and Privacy Engineering to protect user data.

What you'll do

In this role, you'll own the programs central to how Stripe handles privacy at scale. You'll drive end-to-end management across data subject requests, privacy impact assessments, records of processing activities, transfer impact assessments, and cookie compliance, making day-to-day decisions that keep operations regulatory-ready and auditable. You'll also identify where processes can be tightened or automated, and build the documentation and tooling that make the team's work consistent and sustainable.

You'll work as a key connector between Privacy Legal, Privacy Engineering, and cross-functional partners across the company, translating global privacy requirements into practical operations. As a primary point of contact for incoming privacy requests, you'll handle triage and routing, and build the playbooks and response libraries that allow the team to deliver high-quality, consistent privacy experiences for Stripe users and for the regulators who depend on clear, auditable records.

Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end program management across core privacy programs such as data subject requests (DSRs), PIAs and DPIAs, records of processing activities (ROPA), transfer impact assessments (TIAs), and cookie compliance, making day-to-day operational decisions, enforcing processes to ensure regulatory readiness, and measuring compliance at scale 
  • Identify and implement process improvements, including leveraging AI tooling to automate routine tasks, developing structured workflows to sustain quality standards, and maintaining accurate, auditable program records including playbooks and process documentation
  • Create and maintain clear, auditable privacy documentation, including privacy assessments, program playbooks, and customer response libraries, to provide scalable, consistent privacy operational support
  • Work with Privacy Legal and Privacy Engineering to fulfill user requests, build and deepen expertise on global privacy and data-protection requirements, and escalate novel or complex requests with appropriate context and documentation
